summary_1line: A Brahmana explains renunciation, equanimity, and yogic concentration as the path to realizing the soul and attaining liberation in Brahman.

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogin sits in deep meditation as his subtle soul is drawn out from the body like the fibrous pith pulled from a blade of munja grass.
A serene sage sits unmoved amid scenes of decay and death around him, his calm gaze reflecting perfect detachment.
In dreamlike contemplation, a meditator beholds the radiant Supreme Soul within his own heart during samadhi.
